title: spar-exocortex baseline proposal envelope
description: Output of Step 1 — Parse problem + draft baseline. Primary agent emits this single baseline before any attacker dispatch.

algorithmSketch.description: Concise prose describing the approach (data structures, key operations, invariants).

targetComplexity.description: Big-O complexity claim. Must use canonical O(...) notation.

invariantChoice.description: What is precomputed vs computed online. Used by the challenger's anti-overlap check.

targetLanguage.description: Target language for the implementation. Must match an adapter available at preflight.

implementation.description: Self-contained executable text in targetLanguage. Must be runnable by the harness against a standard test set without modification.

operationalAssumptions.description: Optional. Operational assumptions the design relies on (e.g., 'single-threaded reads', 'no concurrent eviction'). Attacker may target these.
